# Game Idea

**Title:** Gravity Maze

- Navigate a ball through a procedurally‑generated maze of platforms using mouse or arrow keys.
- Collect stars for points while racing against a timer.
- **Lose condition:** The ball falls off the canvas or the timer reaches zero.
- Simple physics and canvas drawing make it easy to implement.

1: // Pixel Runner – simple endless side‑scroll runner
2: (() => {
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   // Audio context for simple sound effects
5:   const AudioContext = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
6:   const audioCtx = new AudioContext();
7:   function beep(freq, dur) {
8:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
9:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
10:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
11:     osc.connect(gain);
12:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
13:     osc.start();
14:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime);
15:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
16:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
17:   }
18:   function playJumpSound() { beep(600, 0.1); }
19:   function playCrashSound() { beep(150, 0.4); }
20:   if (!canvas) return; // canvas must exist
21:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
22:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
23:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 400;
24: 
25:   const GRAVITY = 0.6;
26:   const JUMP_SPEED = -12;
27:   const PLAYER_SIZE = 20;
28:    const GROUND_Y = height - 30;
29:    let score = 0;
30:    let lastScoreInt = 0;
31: 
32:   const player = {
33:     x: 50,
34:     y: GROUND_Y - PLAYER_SIZE,
35:     w: PLAYER_SIZE,
36:     h: PLAYER_SIZE,
37:     vy: 0,
38:     onGround: true,
39:     jump() {
40:       if (this.onGround) {
41:         this.vy = JUMP_SPEED;
42:         this.onGround = false;
43:         playJumpSound();
44:     },
45:     update() {
46:       this.vy += GRAVITY;
47:       this.y += this.vy;
48:       if (this.y + this.h >= GROUND_Y) {
49:         this.y = GROUND_Y - this.h;
50:         this.vy = 0;
51:         this.onGround = true;
52:       }
53:     },
54:     draw() {
55:       const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(this.x, this.y, this.x, this.y + this.h);
56:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#ff0');
57:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#ffa500'); // orange gradient
58:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
59:       ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.w, this.h);
60:     }
61:   };
62: 
63:   const obstacles = [];
64:   const OBSTACLE_SPEED = 4;
65:   const OBSTACLE_MIN_GAP = 120;
66:   const OBSTACLE_MAX_GAP = 300;
67:   let nextObstacleIn = OBSTACLE_MIN_GAP;
68: 
69:   function spawnObstacle() {
70:     const w = 20 + Math.random() * 30;
71:     const h = 20 + Math.random() * 30;
72:     obstacles.push({
73:       x: width,
74:       y: GROUND_Y - h,
75:       w,
76:       h
77:     });
78:   }
79: 
80: function updateObstacles() {
81:      nextObstacleIn -= OBSTACLE_SPEED;
82:      if (nextObstacleIn <= 0) {
83:        spawnObstacle();
84:        nextObstacleIn = OBSTACLE_MIN_GAP + Math.random() * (OBSTACLE_MAX_GAP - OBSTACLE_MIN_GAP);
85:      }
86:      for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
87:        const o = obstacles[i];
88:        o.x -= OBSTACLE_SPEED;
89:        if (o.x + o.w < 0) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
90:      }
91:    }
92: 
93:    // clouds
94:    const clouds = [];
95:    const CLOUD_SPEED = 1;
96:    const CLOUD_SPAWN_INTERVAL = 200; // frames
97:    let cloudTimer = CLOUD_SPAWN_INTERVAL;
98:    function spawnCloud() {
99:      const w = 60 + Math.random() * 40;
100:      const h = 30 + Math.random() * 20;
101:      const y = 20 + Math.random() * 80;
102:      clouds.push({ x: width, y, w, h });
103:    }
104:    function updateClouds() {
105:      cloudTimer--;
106:      if (cloudTimer <= 0) {
107:        spawnCloud();
108:        cloudTimer = CLOUD_SPAWN_INTERVAL + Math.random() * 100;
109:      }
110:      for (let i = clouds.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
111:        const c = clouds[i];
112:        c.x -= CLOUD_SPEED;
113:        if (c.x + c.w < 0) clouds.splice(i, 1);
114:      }
115:    }
116:    function drawClouds() {
117:      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
118:      for (const c of clouds) {
119:        ctx.beginPath();
120:        ctx.ellipse(c.x + c.w / 2, c.y + c.h / 2, c.w / 2, c.h / 2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
121:        ctx.fill();
122:      }
123:    }
124: 
125:   function checkCollision() {
126:     for (const o of obstacles) {
127:       if (
128:         player.x < o.x + o.w &&
129:         player.x + player.w > o.x &&
130:         player.y < o.y + o.h &&
131:         player.y + player.h > o.y
132:       ) {
133:         return true;
134:       }
135:     }
136:     return false;
137:   }
138: 
139:   let gameOver = false;
140:   function loop() {
141:     if (gameOver) return;
142:     // background gradient
143:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
144:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#87CEEB'); // sky blue
145:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#fff');
146:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
147:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
148:     // ground
149:     const groundGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, GROUND_Y, 0, height);
150:     groundGrad.addColorStop(0, '#654321');
151:     groundGrad.addColorStop(1, '#332211');
152:     ctx.fillStyle = groundGrad;
153:     ctx.fillRect(0, GROUND_Y, width, height - GROUND_Y);
154:     // simple clouds
155:     drawClouds();
156:     // score display
157:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
158:     ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
159:     ctx.textAlign = 'left';
160:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + Math.floor(score), 10, 30);
161: 
162:     player.update();
163:     player.draw();
164: 
165:     updateObstacles();
166:      updateClouds();
167:      // draw obstacles with gradient
168:      const obsGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
169:      obsGrad.addColorStop(0, '#f33');
170:      obsGrad.addColorStop(1, '#800');
171:      ctx.fillStyle = obsGrad;
172:      for (const o of obstacles) {
173:        ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h);
174:      }
175: 
176:     // update score
177:     score += 0.1;
178:     if (Math.floor(score) > lastScoreInt) {
179:       playJumpSound(); // simple tick sound per point
180:       lastScoreInt = Math.floor(score);
181:     }
182: 
183:     if (checkCollision()) {
184:       gameOver = true;
185:       playCrashSound();
186:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
187:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
188:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
189:       ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
190:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
191:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
192:       return;
193:     }
194:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
195:   }
196: 
197:   // resume audio on interaction
198:   window.addEventListener('click', () => audioCtx.resume());
199:   // input
200:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
201:     if (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'ArrowUp') {
202:       e.preventDefault();
203:       player.jump();
204:     }
205:   });
206: 
207:   // start
208:   loop();
209: })();

(End of file - total 209 lines)
</content>
